description: Azure SQL Database and Elastic Pool scheduled scaling via execution-ledger. Supports DTU and vCore purchasing models, preserves LicenseType (Hybrid Benefit) across DTU↔vCore switches. MSI auth only — no connection strings.

requiredConfig.name: AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
requiredConfig.description: Azure subscription ID containing the SQL Server and databases

requiredConfig.name: AZURE_RESOURCE_GROUP
requiredConfig.description: Resource group containing the SQL Server

requiredConfig.name: AZURE_SQL_MI_CLIENT_ID
requiredConfig.description: Client ID (GUID) of the dedicated UAMI for this pack. Store in App Configuration — never in source control.

requiredRbac.description: Assign to the pack's dedicated UAMI at RG scope — not to a shared worker MSI.
Assign to the pack's dedicated UAMI for reading SKU and LicenseType before resize.
